title: Blue or Roquefort Cheese Dressing, Light

content.title: About
content.content: Blue or Roquefort cheese dressing, light is a low‑calorie creamy dressing made from reduced‑fat cottage cheese, Greek yogurt and flavorful blue cheese. It delivers the characteristic tangy bite of blue cheese while keeping fat and sugar to a minimum, making it suitable for diet‑friendly meals.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Traditional blue cheese matures in caves where Penicillium roqueforti thrives.
The light version swaps heavy cream for low‑fat cottage cheese and yogurt, preserving a smooth texture.
Combining blue cheese with cultured dairy boosts calcium and protein absorption.
In the United States the dressing is popular on salads, vegetable sticks, and seafood dishes.
In Europe it is often served with steaks and roasted potatoes as a lighter alternative to heavy sauces.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Cottage cheese and yogurt provide high‑quality protein essential for muscle repair.

items.title: Low calorie content
items.content: The light dressing contains about 50 kcal per 30 g serving, supporting weight management.

items.title: Calcium source
items.content: Blue cheese and dairy base supply calcium important for bones and teeth.

items.title: Probiotic content
items.content: Greek yogurt adds live cultures that promote gut health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Dairy ingredients are rich in riboflavin (B2) and cobalamin (B12), aiding energy metabolism.

items.title: Dairy allergy or lactose intolerance
items.content: People with milk allergies or lactose sensitivity should avoid this dressing.

items.title: Sodium level
items.content: Blue cheese can be salty; individuals with hypertension should monitor portion size.

items.title: Mold sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals react to Penicillium roqueforti; alternative dressings are recommended if allergic.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Use as a dressing for green salads, raw vegetable sticks, baked potatoes, or as a dip for seafood and grilled chicken. It also works well in sandwiches or as a light base for cold appetizers.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 0–4 °C in a sealed container and consume within 7 days. Discard if the smell or texture changes.
